The generator now discovers specs/state-machines/*.yaml (sorted) instead of a fixed list (decision 22), errors on an empty directory or a bad file name, checks that the yaml name equals the file name, and accepts lower snake-case state values (matching migration 0032) while forbidding a state named same. CT-04a frozen tests still pass.
